note: Literature on YWHAZ/Popov-Chang syndrome explores both dominant-negative mechanisms and loss-of-function/haploinsufficiency effects across missense and truncating variants.

evidence.text: YWHAZ has been linked to Popov-Chang syndrome with reports discussing dominant-negative mechanisms.

source.title: Recent advances in epilepsy genomics and genetic testing
source.quote: YWHAZ Popov-Chang syndrome #618428. CHP1 Spastic ataxia 9, autosomal ... dominant-negative mechanism.

evidence.text: Studies evaluating YWHAZ missense mutations have reported functional impacts on ligand binding energy and phenotypic correlations across missense and loss-of-function variants.

source.title: YWHAZ variation causes intellectual disability and global developmental delay
source.quote: Computational modeling showed that the binding energy was increased in the mutated protein combining with the ligand indicating that the c147A > T variation was a loss-of-function variant.
